name: Testkit full-config email surface
description: Example of a FULL PipeConfig authored verbatim (has pipe_type). The runner posts it to /v1/pipes as-is after substituting ${...} placeholders. Use ${MOCK_URL} for the mock base URL, ${JWT_STRATEGY_ID} for a jwt_bearer source_auth, and ${APIKEY_AGENT_ID} for an api_key_provider source_auth. This one is email-flavored (no source auth; caller identified by the X-Caller-Email header). It targets the Mock LLM 'mock_llm' custom-catalog provider (api_schema openai), so the model id lives in provider.model and the base URL in provider.base_url.
